title: Bradshaw Ranch high strangeness
place_text: Bradshaw Ranch, Secret Canyon, Sedona, Arizona

tellings.quote: The notorious Bradshaw Ranch is ground zero for Sedona's high strangeness.

plain: A property called Bradshaw Ranch, in Secret Canyon near Sedona, Arizona, is said to be the center of Sedona's "high strangeness", a term for clusters of odd, unexplained events. Michels calls it "notorious" and "ground zero" for these happenings, drawing on a book called Merging Dimensions, and he raises it because, if true, it would make the ranch a hot spot for that kind of activity.
